paymentMethods.name_en: Cash at the HAMDI CAF office

paymentMethods.instructions_ar: اشحن بطاقة PostePay باسم HAMDI، رقم 2323232323، في مكتب بريد أو محل تبغ معتمد. احتفظ بالإيصال وأرسله إلينا مع الرقم المرجعي لطلبك (مثال HI-2026-000123).
paymentMethods.instructions_fr: Rechargez la carte PostePay au nom de HAMDI, numéro 232323232232, dans un bureau de poste ou un bureau de tabac agréé. Gardez le reçu et envoyez-le-nous avec le numéro de référence de votre demande (ex. HI-2026-000123).
paymentMethods.instructions_en: Top up the PostePay card in the name of HAMDI, number 232323232323, at a post office or an authorised tobacconist. Keep the receipt and send it to us with your request reference number (e.g. HI-2026-000123).
paymentMethods.instructions_it: Ricarica la carta PostePay intestata a [NOME INTESTATARIO], numero [NUMERO CARTA], in un ufficio postale o in una tabaccheria abilitata. Conserva la ricevuta e inviacela indicando il numero di riferimento della richiesta (es. HI-2026-000123).
paymentMethods.provider_fee_text_ar: يتقاضى مكتب البريد أو المحل رسوم شحن خاصة به.
paymentMethods.provider_fee_text_fr: Le bureau de poste ou le commerce applique ses propres frais de recharge.
paymentMethods.provider_fee_text_en: The post office or shop charges its own top-up fee.
paymentMethods.provider_fee_text_it: L’ufficio postale o la tabaccheria applica una propria commissione di ricarica.

paymentMethods.instructions_ar: ادفع عبر PayPal على الرابط https://paypal.me/hamdimrad واكتب الرقم المرجعي لطلبك (مثال HI-2026-000123) في ملاحظة الدفع.
paymentMethods.instructions_fr: Payez avec PayPal via paypal.me/hamdi et indiquez le numéro de référence de votre demande (ex. HI-2026-000123) dans la note du paiement.
paymentMethods.instructions_en: Pay with PayPal at paypal.me/janesmith and write your request reference number (e.g. HI-2026-000123) in the payment note.
paymentMethods.instructions_it: Paga con PayPal al link https://paypal.me/janesmith e scrivi nella nota del pagamento il numero di riferimento della richiesta (es. HI-2026-000123).
paymentMethods.provider_fee_text_ar: قد يفرض PayPal رسوماً وفق شروطه الخاصة.
paymentMethods.provider_fee_text_fr: PayPal peut appliquer des frais selon ses propres conditions.
paymentMethods.provider_fee_text_en: PayPal may charge fees under its own terms.
paymentMethods.provider_fee_text_it: PayPal può applicare commissioni secondo le proprie condizioni.
